{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting issues
print("Revenue values before cleaning:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning worked
print("\nRevenue values after cleaning:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head(10))

# Check for the 6 QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
